back.target: in, inside (direction: into a place; colloquial short form of herein/hinein)
back.example: Come in, the door is open.

note: The hint "short everyday word" is what rules out the longer forms herein and hinein, so it should stay; adelante-come-in is an interjection ("come in!"), not the adverb, so a null sameAs is right.
